QuestInfo.name: [Getting Colder] Food Keeps You Warm
QuestInfo.1: It's getting colder every day, and the chill is starting to get to you. But never fear! The Maple Administrator wants to help with some nutritional assistance that will keep you warm. Bring her #b10 Nutritious Drumsticks#k to get her aid.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #b10 Nutritious Drumsticks#k to the Maple Administrator to in response to the cold winter weather. In return, you received a title and a buff that makes your body healthier.

0.0: Hi again, #b#h0##k. Winter is here, and it's only going to get colder! \nThe forecast says that TKTKTK is going to be SUPER cold, so we need to prepare!\nI think some tasty, Nutritious Drumsticks are just what we need.

yes.0: Glad you agree! Now, the monsters of Maple World stock up on #bNutritious Drumsticks#k this time of the year for the same reasons that we want them. Of course, monsters don't deserve nice things, so please beat them up, and bring me #b10 of their Nutritious Drumsticks#k. I'll give you something really good for your health if you do, #h0#.

no.0: What, you don't like Drumsticks? They're so nutritious, though! I know this great recipe...
